title: Premium Deck Series: Graveborn: card flavor text

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose fables tell of the Inkwell Leviathan.

entities.name: Inkwell Leviathan
entities.description: A sea creature of Esper fable that swallowed the seventh sea.

entities.name: Dravin
entities.description: A Gruul deserter who dropped his sword upon seeing an archon in battle.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A faction from which Dravin deserted.

entities.name: Blazing Archon
entities.description: A golden-maned, mail-clad archon whose glory made a warrior abandon battle.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and necromancer who speaks of depriving others of their most precious secret.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A figure who declares that others will learn to earn death.

entities.name: Sitrik
entities.description: A birth priest who calls death an outmoded concept.

entities.name: The Patriarch
entities.description: A figure who dreams of vile plague.

events.summary: In Esper fable, the Inkwell Leviathan swallows the seventh sea.
events.quote: "Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains."

events.summary: Dravin sees an archon in battle, drops his sword, and deserts the Gruul.
events.quote: I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war.
